note: The city clerk index of past municipal elections lists Albuquerque elections only in odd-numbered years (2009, 2011, 2013 and so on). Albuquerque elects its mayor every four years in odd-numbered years. The city clerk certificates of canvass state mayoral terms expiring November 30, 2017 (elected 2013) and November 30, 2021 (elected 2017), and the 2017, 2021 and 2025 mayoral elections follow the same four-year cycle. No mayoral election occurred in this year.
